games.title: Against the Storm
games.key_fact: Eremite's roguelite city-builder streams rain-soaked biomes with storm-phase difficulty scaling.
games.plus: Storm-phase global modifiers rewire the economy simulation each cycle.
games.minus: Late-settlement settler pathfinding and AI load spike on large glades.
games.patches: 1.0 launch (2023) plus DLC-era patches tuned balance and stability.
games.map_note: Roguelite-generated settlements; storm modifiers plus settler AI drive the mapping.

games.key_fact: Remedy's Northlight requires mesh-shader GPUs (GTX 10 unsupported) and DLSS/FSR even at Low; a ray and path tracing showcase.
games.map_note: Dual-protagonist hubs; RT global illumination and volumetrics.
games.minus: Steep requirements and Epic-only PC release angered many.
games.patches: March 2024 patch lowered the minimum GPU to GTX 1070-class.
games.plus: ECS object model, pixel-precise occlusion culling and DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction.
games.title: Alan Wake 2

games.key_fact: Custom Cathode engine built for a single game; the xenomorph runs on a dual-AI system that hunts by sound and sight.
games.map_note: Station-hub horror; stalking AI pathfinding and shadow-driven stealth.
games.minus: AI perception rubber-banding and 32-bit PC quirks frustrate stealth purists.
games.patches: 2020 Windows Store build (Lab42) fixed lingering PC issues.
games.plus: Unscripted alien AI with senses-driven search keeps encounters unrepeatable.
games.rec_cpu: Phenom II X4 955 / Core 2 Quad Q9650
games.title: Alien: Isolation

games.key_fact: Соло-разработка Билли Бассо за 7 лет на самописном C++ движке без сторонних зависимостей; вся игра около 33МБ.
games.map_note: Хаб-метроидвания с секретами: кастомная физика и частицы поверх пиксель-арта.
games.minus: Закрытый движок без официальной поддержки модов.
games.plus: Доморощенный движок и редактор уровней дали 33МБ игры с симуляцией жидкостей.
games.title: Animal Well

games.key_fact: Флагман Real Virtuality 4 (DX11, PhysX): платформа модов и миссий; производительность упирается в CPU из-за AI-симуляции.
games.map_note: Гигантские открытые террейны со стриммингом, AI-экосистемой и сеткодом.
games.minus: Однопоточно-зависимая симуляция: FPS падает от числа AI-юнитов, а не графики.
games.patches: Долгая поддержка и Creator DLC (напр. Spearhead 1944)
games.plus: Редактор Eden и Workshop: десятки тысяч миссий и модов (оттуда вырос DayZ).
games.title: Arma 3

games.key_fact: FromSoftware's first 120fps PC game; mission-based mech action with deep assembly customization and a NG++ story structure.
games.map_note: Mission arenas with boost physics and heavy VFX; single-player focused.
games.minus: Modest PC graphics options with no ultrawide or ray-tracing extras at launch.
games.patches: Regulation balance patches tuned parts and PvP after launch.
games.plus: Free respec and part swapping encourage build experimentation at no cost.
games.title: Armored Core 6: Fires of Rubicon

games.key_fact: Покер-roguelike на 150MB: вся логика — сиды рандома и модификаторы джокеров; достаточно OpenGL 2.1 и iGPU.
games.map_note: Арена забегов (один экран): пост-эффекты и система сейвов.
games.minus: Нет recommended-тира; графических опций почти нет.
games.plus: Нулевой GPU-барьер (интегрированная графика) и мгновенные загрузки.
games.title: Balatro

games.key_fact: 2000 Infinity Engine classic; pre-rendered 2D backgrounds and sprite characters keep it trivially runnable today via Enhanced Edition and GOG builds.
games.map_note: Chapter-hub CRPG with 6-player co-op; party pathfinding and sprite animation.
games.minus: Original pathfinding and 800x600-era UI scale poorly without Enhanced Edition fixes.
games.patches: Beamdog Enhanced Edition (2013) and 2.x patches modernized the codebase.
games.plus: Hand-painted 2D areas age gracefully and cost almost nothing to render.
games.title: Baldur's Gate 2

games.key_fact: Forged with the new Divinity 4.0 engine (описание Steam): пошаговые бои, вертикальность локаций и 174 часа синематиков; SSD на 150GB обязателен.
games.map_note: Хаб-акты и пошаговые бои: анимация партии, поиск пути ИИ, тени, физика, кооп-сеткод и сейвы.
games.minus: 150GB install и тяжелый третий акт для CPU в городе.
games.patches: Patch 8 (апрель 2025, финальный): cross-play, фоторежим, 12 сабклассов.
games.plus: Кооп до 4 игроков, cross-play и официальные моды (Toolkit).
games.title: Baldur's Gate 3

games.key_fact: Enhanced-сборка классики: кампания с паузой, кооп и cross-play мультиплеер при 4GB install и OpenGL 2.0.
games.map_note: Хаб-главы и зоны: анимация партии, поиск пути, кооп-сеткод и сейвы.
games.minus: Нет recommended-тира; спрайтовая 2D-графика без современного рендера.
games.plus: Онлайн и LAN-кооп кампании.
games.title: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
Blue Prince
games.key_fact: Roguelite manor drafts shifting rooms daily with persistent blueprint puzzle logic across runs.
games.plus: Daily-draft room logic persists clues across runs elegantly.
games.minus: Fixed interaction systems and uneven framerates on low-end GPUs.
games.patches: Post-launch patches fixed progression blockers and stability.
games.map_note: Manor hub redrafted daily; run persistence plus room logic drive the mapping.

games.key_fact: In development since 2010, Caves of Qud left Early Access with 1.0 in December 2024; its hybrid handcrafted and procedural world simulates physical, social and historical layers.
games.map_note: Tile-based roguelike with permadeath runs and simulated history; creature pathfinding plus persistent saves.
games.minus: Archaic tile UI and minimal spec hide late-game slowdowns in dense procedural zones.
games.patches: 1.0 launch (Dec 2024) capped a decade of Early Access updates.
games.plus: Deep emergent simulation where a handwritten story runs through systemic physical and social layers.
games.title: Caves of Qud

games.key_fact: Unreal Engine 4 64-player medieval warfare with cross-play; Torn Banner moved from Source-mod roots to UE4.
games.map_note: 64-player online battlefields; melee animation and ragdoll physics.
games.minus: Team-objective modes live or die by server health and matchmaking quality.
games.plus: 64-player melee netcode keeps directional combat readable at scale.
games.title: Chivalry 2
Cities: Skylines
games.key_fact: Colossal Order's Unity city sim leans on agent-based traffic; huge modded cities bottleneck the single-threaded simulation.
games.plus: Agent-based traffic and water sims scale toward 100k-plus citizen cities.
games.minus: Single-threaded simulation chokes on heavily modded maximum-population cities.
games.patches: DLC-era patches fixed traffic and AI bugs; support wound down after the sequel.
games.map_note: Sandbox city simulation; traffic crowds plus water/AI sims drive the mapping.

games.key_fact: Нарративная RPG на кубиках и настольных часах: каждый цикл — распределение костей по задачам на колесе станции.
games.map_note: Хаб-станция с ветвящимися узлами: выборы и сейвы, без экшен-симуляций.
games.minus: Статичные портреты и фоны вместо анимации и симуляции.
games.plus: Настольная система clocks: дедлайны и риски честно моделируются счётчиками.
games.title: Citizen Sleeper
City of Heroes: Homecoming
games.rec_cpu: Intel Core i-Series or AMD Ryzen
games.key_fact: Fan-run servers preserve the 2004 superhero MMO on modern systems with a 64-bit client and Ultra Mode graphics options.
games.plus: Ultra Mode plus 64-bit client lift draw distance and stability on 20-year-old assets.
games.minus: 2004-era engine caps fidelity, and integrated graphics cannot hold Ultra Mode framerates.
games.patches: Homecoming added the 64-bit client and ships ongoing Issue patches with powerset and stability fixes.
games.map_note: Instanced city zones around hubs; 8-hero teams and zone events drive the mapping.

games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.key_fact: Sandfall's UE5 debut uses Lumen, Nanite and MetaHumans with about 95 percent built in Blueprints by under 30 people.
games.plus: Lumen and Nanite deliver painterly lighting without manual LOD work.
games.minus: UE5 shader-compilation stutter and high VRAM demands marked the launch.
games.patches: Launch patches targeted stutter, ultrawide and HDR issues.
games.map_note: Linear expedition zones; stated fps tiers quoted verbatim, Lumen GI confirmed by UE interview.

games.key_fact: Одна из первых игр с полным набором RTX (отражения, диффузная GI, контактные тени) на Northlight; на релизе была крайне требовательна к GPU.
games.map_note: Хаб Oldest House с деструкцией и RT-GI: физика и динамическое освещение первичны.
games.minus: GPU-аппетит: без DLSS трассировку не тянула даже RTX 2080 Ti в 1080p.
games.plus: Масштабная деструктивность окружения, обсчитываемая физикой Northlight.
games.title: Control

games.key_fact: Valve's Source 2 upgrade adds volumetric smokes and sub-tick updates; Steam lists minimum specs only.
games.map_note: Tactical arenas; online netcode with volumetric smoke particles.
games.minus: Launch optimization gaps and missing modes drew steady criticism.
games.patches: Continuous Valve updates since the Sept 2023 launch.
games.plus: Dynamic smoke that bullets and HE grenades reshape mid-round.
games.title: Counter-Strike 2
Crusader Kings III
games.key_fact: Clausewitz grand strategy with a 3D map and thousands of AI agents; tiers span a GTX 660 minimum to a GTX 970 recommended.
games.plus: Text-serializable simulation with deep Workshop mod support.
games.minus: Heavily CPU-bound in late centuries; perf varies by AI count.
games.map_note: Sandbox dynastic map; AI agents with multiplayer and long saves.

games.key_fact: Massive Monster's Unity 2.5D roguelite blends dungeon runs with a base sim; Unholy Alliance (2024) added co-op.
games.map_note: Base hub plus procedural dungeons; follower AI and saves.
games.minus: Late-game bases with big flocks can chug on minimum spec.
games.patches: Relics of the Old Faith and Unholy Alliance (co-op) updates.
games.plus: Custom 2.5D lighting over sprites delivers a premium look on decade-old GPUs.
games.title: Cult of the Lamb

games.key_fact: REDengine 4 open world had a disastrous 2020 launch; Update 2.0 plus Phantom Liberty overhauled systems and added RT Overdrive path tracing.
games.map_note: Dense open city with crowds, RT global illumination and streaming.
games.minus: Launch CPU threading and streaming performance, especially on old consoles and HDDs.
games.patches: Update 2.0 plus Phantom Liberty overhaul; RT Overdrive and ongoing fixes.
games.plus: Path-traced Overdrive mode became a benchmark showcase with DLSS 3.5.
games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
Dark Souls Remastered
games.key_fact: QLOC remaster running at 60fps with dedicated servers for up to 6 players; Steam notes state 1080p/60 on Low minimum and High recommended.
games.plus: Native 60fps remaster with dedicated-server multiplayer for up to 6.
games.minus: Minimal visual overhaul versus the original with DSFix-era expectations.
games.patches: Day-one network and password-matchmaking fixes carried from the original.
games.map_note: Interconnected Lordran; invasion netcode with boss AI.

games.title: Dave the Diver
games.rec_cpu: Intel Core i5 Hexa / i7 Quad
games.key_fact: 2.5D pixel-art diving sim blends real-time underwater zones with a management sim and holds stable 60fps on low-spec hardware.
games.plus: Day/night depth zones stream fish AI and events without loading screens.
games.minus: Fixed-function 2D pipeline offers little resolution scaling or modding headroom.
games.patches: Post-launch patches fixed controller and stability bugs; free collab DLCs (Dredge, Godzilla) added content.
games.map_note: Dive zones plus sushi-bar hub loop; fish AI and run persistence drive the mapping.

games.title: Dead Cells
games.key_fact: Motion Twin's custom Heaps engine holds fast 60fps roguelike combat with near-instant biome reloads.
games.plus: Custom engine enables instant restarts and mod support with a tiny footprint.
games.minus: 2.5D sprite pipeline limits lighting and post-processing depth.
games.patches: Final 'The End is Near' update (2024) closed new content; balance hotfixes continue.
games.map_note: Sequential branching biomes per run; fast combat animation and run saves drive the mapping.

games.title: Death Stranding
games.key_fact: Decima-engine port brought ultrawide support, DLSS and 60fps-plus gameplay to the asynchronous strand world.
games.plus: Asynchronous structure sharing creates MMO-like cooperation without live servers.
games.minus: Empty terrain traversal exposes texture pop-in on HDD installs.
games.patches: Director's Cut (2022) added XeSS, ultrawide tweaks and new traversal gear.
games.map_note: Vast streamed terrain with asynchronous online features only; single-player per store tags.

games.key_fact: Unreal Engine 4 co-op shooter with fully destructible procedurally generated caves; four classes with complementary traversal tools.
games.map_note: Procedural destructible caves; 4-player online co-op with physics-based digging.
games.minus: Swarm-heavy scenes and particle load can strain weaker GPUs.
games.patches: Years of free Season updates added biomes, missions and weapons.
games.plus: Procedural cave networks that can never be solved, forcing improvisation.
games.title: Deep Rock Galactic
Destiny 2
games.key_fact: Bungie's Tiger engine streams patrol zones with physics; the 2020 Beyond Light overhaul upgraded lighting and vaulted content.
games.plus: Seamless patrol-to-activity handoffs with cross-play netcode.
games.minus: Content vaulting plus shader recompiles cause launch-window stutter.
games.patches: Beyond Light engine and lighting overhaul; seasonal patches tune HDR, loads and cross-play.
games.map_note: Tower hub plus streamed patrol zones; 6-player raids and activity netcode drive the mapping.

games.key_fact: Игра 2000 года на Unreal Engine 1; на современных ОС живёт за счёт Kentie's Deus Exe и D3D10/D3D11-рендеров.
games.map_note: Хабы-миссии с AI-патрулями и мультирешениями: стелс-AI и сейвы.
games.minus: Однопоточный движок 2000 года: глюки разрешений и скорости без фанатских фиксов.
games.patches: Community: Kentie's Deus Exe и D3D10/D3D11-рендеры
games.plus: Системный иммерсив-сим: аугментации, навыки и мультипути поверх UE1-скриптов.
games.title: Deus Ex

games.key_fact: 2000 sprite-based ARPG with up to 8-player Battle.net; Resurrected (2021) overlays 3D art on the same 2D logic.
games.map_note: Act hubs with 8-player online; mob AI and character saves.
games.minus: Fixed 800x600 2D presentation without the Resurrected remaster.
games.patches: Patch 1.14 (2016) added modern Windows support.
games.plus: Procedural dungeons and loot-seed system still run at trivial cost.
games.title: Diablo 2

games.key_fact: Нарративная RPG без экшена: нагрузка — 2D/3D-сцены Ревашоля и скрипты диалогов; rec-тир просит GTX 1060 и 8GB RAM.
games.map_note: Хаб (районы Ревашоля): анимация персонажей, поиск пути NPC, запеченный свет и сейвы.
games.minus: Нет perf-целей; CPU-вилка расплывчата (от Core 2 Duo до Core i7).
games.plus: Низкий порог входа (совместимая DX11-карта с 512MB).
games.title: Disco Elysium

games.key_fact: Final Cut-версия нарративной RPG: нагрузка — 2D/3D-сцены Ревашоля и скрипты диалогов; rec-тир просит GTX 1060 и 8GB RAM.
games.map_note: Хаб (районы Ревашоля): анимация персонажей, поиск пути NPC, запеченный свет и сейвы.
games.minus: Нет perf-целей; CPU-вилка расплывчата (от Core 2 Duo до Core i7).
games.plus: Низкий порог входа (совместимая DX11-карта с 512MB).
games.title: Disco Elysium: The Final Cut

games.key_fact: Arkane's Void Engine debut; notorious 2016 PC launch performance (frame pacing, mouse issues) was later fixed by patches.
games.map_note: Mission-hub immersive sim; guard AI pathfinding and shadow stealth systems.
games.minus: Launch-day PC stutter and steep requirements soured reception.
games.patches: Post-launch performance patches plus a free New Game Plus update.
games.plus: Clockwork Mansion and time-manipulation levels showcase dynamic geometry.
games.title: Dishonored 2

games.key_fact: Divinity Engine с редактором и Game Master-режимом; Definitive Edition — бесплатный апгрейд с переписанной третьей главой.
games.map_note: Крупные хабы-регионы с элементальными поверхностями: физика, частицы и кооп-сейвы.
games.minus: Сплит-скрин на ПК ограничен двумя игроками при онлайне на четверых.
games.patches: Definitive Edition (2018): бесплатный апгрейд оригинала
games.plus: Редактор Divinity Engine 2 и Game Master-режим со скриптами Osiris.
games.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2

games.key_fact: Переиздание DOOM+DOOM II с онлайном (кооп, PvP, cross-play) при 2GB install; требования — от современного ремастера (GTX 650 Ti / 8GB).
games.map_note: Линейные эпизоды с аренами: поиск пути демонов, анимация спрайтов, сеткод и сейвы.
games.minus: Требования ремастера выше оригинала 1993 года; perf-цели не указаны.
games.plus: Онлайн кооп/PvP и split-screen при футпринте 2GB.
games.title: Doom (1993)

games.key_fact: id Tech 6 (hybrid forward/deferred): Vulkan-патч дал плюс 30–40% на AMD через async compute (DF замеры).
games.map_note: Линейные миссии с аренами: динамические тени, партиклы, анимация демонов, ИИ и сеткод.
games.minus: На релизе OpenGL-путь душил AMD-карты до драйверов и Vulkan-патча.
games.patches: Vulkan-патч (июль 2016): async compute и мультитрединг рендера.
games.plus: 60fps-таргет с динамическим светом и TSSAA.
games.title: Doom (2016)

games.key_fact: id Tech 7 отказался от мегатекстур в пользу стриминга и перешёл на Vulkan; Digital Foundry фиксировала 300-500fps на топ-ПК.
games.map_note: Линейные арены с волнами демонов: частицы, тени и анимации добиваний.
games.minus: Отказ от OpenGL: рендер только через Vulkan.
games.patches: RT-апгрейд (2021); Horde Mode в обновлении 6.66
games.plus: Джобовая архитектура без main/render-потока: воркер на каждое ядро CPU.
games.title: DOOM Eternal
Dragon Age: Origins
games.key_fact: BioWare's Eclipse toolset shipped with a full mod construction set while tactics AI ran on single-threaded 2009 CPUs.
games.plus: Toolset plus scriptable party tactics gave unusually deep companion AI for its era.
games.minus: Single-threaded pathfinding slows down in large Ostagar-scale battles.
games.patches: Final 1.05 patch (2011) fixed memory and quest bugs; no further official support.
games.map_note: Hub-connected quest maps; party pathfinding and tactical AI drive the mapping.

games.title: Dusk
games.key_fact: New Blood's Unity boomer-shooter holds high framerates with lo-fi Quake-style levels plus DuskWorld multiplayer.
games.plus: Lo-fi art direction sustains high framerates with fast movement tech.
games.minus: Dated lightmap pipeline offers no modern global-illumination options.
games.patches: Post-launch multiplayer (DuskWorld) and Workshop support extended content and mods.
games.map_note: Linear retro episodes; store tags confirm online PvP, mapped with lightmaps and netcode.

games.key_fact: Глубокая симуляция крепости (сотни дварфов, жидкости, поиск пути) на двух ядрах; Steam-версия добавила тайлсет и звук при 500MB install.
games.map_note: Процедурная генерация мира и симуляция крепости: поиск пути, толпы дварфов и сейвы.
games.minus: Нет GPU-рекомендаций и perf-целей; fps зависит от размера форта и населения.
games.plus: Крошечный футпринт (500MB) при огромной системной симуляции.
games.title: Dwarf Fortress
Echo Point Nova
games.key_fact: Solo-dev hoverboard FPS streams open combat arenas with Titanfall-like momentum and online co-op.
games.plus: Momentum hoverboard traversal across open combat arenas.
games.minus: Solo-dev scope limits enemy variety and long-tail content.
games.map_note: Open combat arenas; store tags confirm online co-op, mapped with AI and netcode.

games.key_fact: Первый DX12-тайтл FromSoftware: JIT-компиляция шейдеров давала статтеры до 250мс; кап 60fps, без ультравайда и апскейлеров на релизе.
games.map_note: Открытый мир Междуземья: стриминг, большой террейн, тени, анимация боссов, ИИ и сеткод.
games.minus: Патч 1.09 добавил RT-тени/AO с потерей около 35% fps без DLSS/FSR.
games.patches: Патч 1.09 добавил RT; статтеры обхода сохранялись и к выходу Erdtree (DF, 2024).
games.plus: Онлайн кооп и PvP поверх открытого мира.
games.title: Elden Ring
Fallout: New Vegas
games.key_fact: Obsidian Gamebryo open world with a single minimum tier; community patches fix the well-known stutter and 4GB memory limits.
games.plus: Dense quest scripting with faction-reputation systems on old hardware.
games.minus: 32-bit memory ceiling and save bloat cause crashes without community fixes.
games.patches: No major official tech patches; community 4GB patch and NVSE carry the load.
games.map_note: Open Mojave wasteland; streamed cells with companion AI and long saves.

games.title: Final Fantasy XIV
games.key_fact: Square Enix MMO with a 140GB install; current tiers require a GTX 970 minimum and an RTX 2060 recommended with 16GB RAM.
games.plus: Seamless duty instancing with cross-datacenter travel on a live MMO.
games.minus: 140GB footprint and engine-bound UI modding limits.
games.patches: Each expansion (most recently Dawntrail) raises GPU and storage floors.
games.map_note: Zoned hubs with duties; light-party 4-player co-op and raid crowds.

games.key_fact: Ремастер игры 2001 года (ПК — 2016) с перерисованными моделями поверх пререндерных фонов; пошаговая CTB-система.
games.map_note: Линейный маршрут по Спире с пререндерами: запечённый свет и анимации.
games.minus: Коридорная структура без открытого мира и свободы перемещения.
games.plus: Пререндерные фоны с запечённым светом, пережившие 15 лет без потери вида.
games.title: Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster

games.key_fact: Battle Royale переведён на UE 5.1 в Chapter 4 (Nanite, Lumen, Virtual Shadow Maps, TSR); для слабых ПК есть Performance Mode.
games.map_note: Арена-остров на 100 игроков с Lumen-GI и сеткодом: масштаб и мультиплеер первичны.
games.minus: Nanite и Lumen требуют DX12 и мощную GPU; Performance Mode сильно режет картинку.
games.patches: Chapter 4 перевёл BR на UE 5.1 (Nanite/Lumen)
games.plus: Лестница масштабирования от Intel HD 4000 до Nanite/Lumen на DX12.
games.title: Fortnite

games.key_fact: Градостроитель выживания с симуляцией тепла вокруг генератора, законами и недовольством/надеждой горожан.
games.map_note: Одна арена-кратер с симуляцией толпы горожан и тепловых зон.
games.minus: Одна фиксированная карта-кратер без процедурных карт.
games.plus: Зональная симуляция тепла: каждый дом и рабочее место считаются от источника.
games.title: Frostpunk

games.key_fact: Subset's 2D spaceship roguelike runs on a 2GHz CPU with 1GB RAM; the free Advanced Edition (2014) expanded systems.
games.map_note: Procedural sectors; suspend-save roguelike structure.
games.minus: No mid-run saves and fixed 1280x720-era scaling.
games.patches: Advanced Edition (2014) free expansion added ships and systems.
games.plus: System-level ship simulation (power, crew, fire, breaches) from kilobytes of state.
games.title: FTL: Faster Than Light

games.key_fact: Facepunch's Source physics sandbox with 300,000-plus free Workshop items; thousands still play online daily.
